description: This file defines the interface for plugins within the WPEFramework, including the IPlugin interface and related extension interfaces, security, WebSocket, and channel handling. It specifies the structure for plugin lifecycle management, communication, and security.

classes.name: IPlugin
classes.description: Interface for plugin lifecycle management, including initialization, deinitialization, and information retrieval.

classes.name: IPluginExtended
classes.description: Extension of IPlugin with methods for attaching and detaching communication channels.

classes.name: IWeb
classes.description: Interface for handling web requests and responses.

classes.name: IChannel
classes.description: Interface for raw data channel communication.

classes.name: ISecurity
classes.description: Interface for security validation and token management.

classes.name: IAuthenticate
classes.description: Interface for creating tokens and officer security interface.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Called when a plugin changes state.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided shell.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns metadata information about the plugin.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles incoming web requests or data.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes a web request and returns a response.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles incoming WebSocket or text socket data.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles incoming raw data on a channel.

methods.name: Outbound
methods.description: Sends raw data over a channel.

methods.name: Allowed
methods.description: Checks if a WebSocket upgrade or request is allowed.

methods.name: Officer
methods.description: Returns a security interface for a given token.
